title: Pretraining and fine-tuning
summary: Pretraining teaches broad patterns from a large training collection. Fine-tuning further adjusts a model using a more specific collection or training task.
introduction: Pretraining teaches broad patterns from a large training collection. Fine-tuning further adjusts a model using a more specific collection or training task. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Pretraining teaches broad patterns from a large training collection. Fine-tuning further adjusts a model using a more specific collection or training task.

blocks.code:
Pretraining goal: learn broad text patterns
Fine-tuning goal: adapt behaviour using selected examples
Evaluation goal: check useful results and new failures
blocks.title: Pretraining and fine-tuning

blocks.text: Both training stages change model numbers. Supplying a source passage in one request is different: it changes the current context.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain whether adding a paragraph to a prompt is fine-tuning.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Fine-tuning does not guarantee that every fact in the examples will be recalled correctly.
For more detail later, use this [Large Language Models further reading](https://huggingface.co/learn/llm-course/chapter1/1).
